projects.runCause: Further in: InvalidCastException (String to Frame) at SampleViewer.cs:54. InteractiveAnimationsExample.PageLoaded sets IsChecked on a RadioButton inside a Page hosted in a Frame; its Checked event bubbles to SampleViewer's RadioButton.Checked handler with args.Source still the inner RadioButton (string content), so (Frame)theButton.Content fails. In WPF the page in a Frame is not a logical child, so Source is adjusted to the outer RadioButton at that boundary (cause inferred from the stack, not verified on WPF)
